messages:
olivia (docs): Quick sync — API surface triage for the June sprint. Need decisions on function-calling shape + structured outputs, plus what examples/docs we require for Python/TS clients. Thoughts?

jordan (sdk): Can we keep chat/completions distinct? Customers expect different semantics. We could expose separate endpoints but reuse shared types in the SDK. Overloads in TS would help.

mike (pm): @jordan I lean explicit endpoints: chat, completions, embeddings, rerank. SDKs can unify shapes behind helpers. Launch criteria: SDKs updated, examples for each endpoint, changelog and migration guide.

sasha (engineer): Engineering risk note — function-calling is stable for v1, but structured output (schema enforcement + validation) needs runtime hooks. I propose an opt-in `output_schema` parameter that triggers validation server-side.

anna (devex): :thumbsup: From DevEx: we need an examples matrix — python + ts for chat+functions, embeddings batching, rerank examples, and schema parsing snippets. Also runnable notebooks for quickstarts.

jordan (sdk): Quick TS types sketch:
```ts
type Message = { role: 'user'|'assistant'|'system'; content: string }
interface ChatCreate { model: string; messages: Message[]; functions?: FunctionDef[]; output_schema?: JSONSchema }
```
Will mirror names/types in Python client.

nish (evals): Evals requirement: add deterministic regression tests — one for structured-output correctness, one for function-calling fallback behavior. Need example fixtures.

olivia (docs): Scope negotiation: a customer asked for streaming structured outputs for low-latency apps. Can we ship blocking schema validation first, streaming later? ETA?

sasha (engineer): Ship blocking structured outputs in sprint 2 (~2 weeks) as opt-in. Streaming structured output needs runtime framing work (KV cache + delimiting) — estimate ~6 weeks. Plan: v1 blocking + docs, v2 streaming.

mike (pm): Agreed. Launch checklist (minimum): API spec doc, SDK PRs merged (py/ts), examples in docs repo, changelog entry + migration guide, SDK release notes, 2 smoke e2e tests. Need owners.

jordan (sdk): I'll own the TS SDK PRs + TS examples and type tests. ETA: PRs by 1768200000.

olivia (docs): I'll own docs, migration guide, and Python examples with help from @jordan. Will draft templates for the examples page.

anna (devex): DevEx will supply notebooks + quickstart + two runnable examples. We'll also add a single-line config flag for feature rollout on hosted: `structured_output=true` to gate opt-in users.

deploy-bot: deploy:staging chat-api v1.43 promoted by ci-bot at 1768123520

sasha (engineer): I'll own server-side impl + perf tests and add the schema validation hook and opt-in flag. Will coordinate a canary with infra.

mike (pm): Decision summary: separate endpoints retained, optional `output_schema` param for structured outputs, blocking structured output ships in sprint 2, streaming in ~6 weeks, owners assigned. I'll publish an RFC + PR checklist.

olivia (docs): Thanks team — I'll open the docs issue + examples checklist and tag assignees. Please add blockers to that issue. :sparkles:
